answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the types regenerated from the running API differ from the committed api-types.d.ts (new fields such as has_more and last_verified_at appear as additions). The branch changed the API without regenerating and committing the types. This is deterministic, so a re-run on the same commit will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
